Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production UI DESIGN BOARD showing FOUR distinct mobile Kamayuu app screens side-by-side, evenly sized portrait rectangles, no phone hardware, on a wide canvas with clear spacing. This is a concrete visual blueprint for coding. Use the two attached CURRENT Kamayuu homepage and sign-in screens as the brand references. This is NOT Lotus Buzzer. No lotus, flowers, crown, generic purple gaming UI, stock dashboard cards or generic esports shield. Match the existing midnight sapphire, near-black lacquer, engraved aged brass, antique gold, amber lantern edge light and parchment-cream type. Texture and scene: hints of the same candlelit lakeside palace and card table behind very dark translucent navy panels, quiet contrast, crisp thin double brass borders and small compass/crescent accents. Large elegant readable serif titles with small spaced sans-serif labels, restrained premium hierarchy. No busy glow. Buttons broad comfortable tappable warm-brass primary with beveled corners, secondary navy outlined. Each screen a complete working layout with close arrow, no clipped content.
SCREEN 1 Ranked 1v1: eyebrow 'THE RANKED TABLES'; elegant title 'Find your next rival'; large distinctive copper compass Bronze badge; 'BRONZE' and '600 Rating'; a small real progress bar '250 to Silver'; five tiny tier symbols Bronze Silver Gold Platinum Diamond; navy bordered inset for the two-card-cut loading artwork; status 'Finding your next table'; 'Looking for an opponent…'; bottom full width 'Cancel search'; calm footer 'Human-first matchmaking'.
SCREEN 2 Leaderboard: eyebrow 'THE HONOR ROLL'; title 'Leaderboard'; top navy hero 'Season 1' with slim golden divider; top three leaderboard rows with unique metallic tier badges instead of generic avatars; follow with ranks 4 to 7; sample names You, Arjun, Meera, Kai, Hana, Ravi, Anika; columns rank player rating, compact wins beneath name; make bot benchmark rows explicitly marked 'AI benchmark'; important sober small note 'AI rivals have fixed benchmark ratings.'; a subtle outlined 'Next page' button. No invented online indicators.
SCREEN 3 Results: eyebrow 'HAND COMPLETE'; prominent gold compass medallion, title 'You take the hand'; subtitle '8 points · lowest at the table'; two large restrained score rows You 8, Arjun 19, card counts; a beautiful inset dark 'Another hand?' panel; primary button 'Request rematch'; secondary 'Find another opponent'; quiet 'View table' control.
SCREEN 4 Rematch invitation: eyebrow 'THE NEXT HAND'; title 'One more round?'; overlapping sapphire crescent card artworks with brass ornament; 'Arjun has invited you to play again'; subtle outlined countdown coin '18s'; primary 'Accept rematch'; outlined 'No thanks'; small helper 'Your next hand starts after both accept.'.
High-fidelity original bespoke design, cohesive with references, realistic mobile spacing 44px targets, no filler charts. Large sharp output.
